bio: This is the successful story of an old family business that initially started life as a café. Located along one of the main streets in Pals, it features a dining room with high ceilings that combines a pleasant contemporary look with more traditional decorative details that link it with its past (bar, floors, furniture etc). The chef, who has trained in a number of leading restaurants, creates elaborate traditional cuisine with an imaginative touch that never fails to please guests and includes several interesting seasonal dishes and a few rice options (such as black rice with squid and a pear aioli and rice with pork rib and confit boletus mushrooms)....
